role: Non-author review of selected new runner/manifest and root workflow, source-map and reader deltas. Prior platform r2 review is not repeated.
verdict: No blocking issue found in the selected source delta; actual Windows execution remains pending.
scope: Current git diff for windows-p27-native.ps1 and windows-p27-native.yml; original P27/PE behavior reviewed only for preservation.

checks.result: Exactly seven parent FQNs: six ordinary and one explicitly ignored same-build-helper case. Both ignored child dispatchers excluded. Manifest schema/booleans/helper requirement/FQN order/names are validated and current declarations exist.

Reads original inputs-before and selection at expected head, requires exact current tracked source map, selected libtest in debug/deps and exact sibling debug/farfold.exe, lowercase SHA256 match. Rechecks source and both program hashes before/after each parent and at end. Same-helper fixture derives that exact sibling helper. No rebuild/download/fallback/environment switch.

Each parent uses original Popen object, 90-second observation and five-second bounded retirement/drain, no PID relookup or tree kill. Pass requires natural nonterminated exit int0, settled error-free EOF on both pipes, <=1MiB each, exactly one matching ok libtest line and 1/0/0/0 summary, stable inputs/programs. Forced, timed-out, overflowing, unknown output/process cannot pass; unsettled parent/output prevents later parents.

One exclusively new helper-stdin-controls directory and per-case exclusive files. Reader threads own pipe closure and bounded capture buffers; pending reads are not closed by relay. Original parent objects retained; no deletion of source or original evidence.

stdin step is a separate always-run 13-minute group after original P27. Root job budget rises 35 to48 for added work; original P27 28-minute step and PE/loader five-minute steps and pass/fail bodies unchanged. Python nonzero exits propagate; no continue-on-error success conversion. All groups retain separate receipts and native screenshot acceptance is not replaced.

PS delta reverses byte-exactly to HEAD after removing the two new source paths. Runner uses matching seven source patterns. Existing r5 reader remains unchanged; new file AST reverses exactly to r5 by removing just the two path strings. Recovery/null/legacy parsing semantics unchanged.

independentControls.kind: pure parser/in-memory record and manifest controls; no subprocess or Windows API execution
